Verbatim license notices embedded in source-map.js (a webpack bundle).
The first notice heads the bundle's modules; the second states the full
terms carried by the Base 64 VLQ module (Mozilla source-map, based on the
Closure Compiler implementation).

--- first module's notice (source-map.js lines 57-61) ---
	/*
	 * Copyright 2009-2011 Mozilla Foundation and contributors
	 * Licensed under the New BSD license. See LICENSE.txt or:
	 * http://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-3-Clause
	 */
